source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Request risk management to determine which party is legally liable before the treatment values and goals are clarified.","B":"Request a routine discharge-planning conference even though the unresolved issue is an ethical conflict about treatment.","C":"Request a healthcare ethics consultation to help clarify values, options, and ethically supportable approaches to the disagreement.","D":"Request security to resolve the disagreement because treatment-value conflicts are primarily behavioral-management problems."}}
source_row.rationale: The VA National Center for Ethics in Health Care describes ethics consultation as a resource for uncertainty or conflict about what should be done in healthcare. Ethics consultants work with patients, families, and staff to clarify options and help resolve ethically difficult concerns; they are not misconduct investigators.
source_row.source_detail: Ethics consultation is a resource for uncertainty or conflict about what should be done in health care and helps clarify ethically supportable options.
